lessons.title: People in my family
objectives: Use family nouns and possessive adjectives my, your, his, and her.
Use family words in one short, clear everyday exchange.

content_sections.title: Language focus
content_sections.body: In lesson 11: family words, notice this model: This is my sister. Her name is Anh. Keep the word order short and make the meaning clear.
